detail: Divestment of two strata units in Suntec City Office completed in FY2025; $15.4m of strata units divested at an average price 19.6% above book value to Nava Bharat (Singapore) Pte. Limited. Net proceeds from divestment of investment properties $30,554k; profit from divestments $4,798k (Group).
valuation_basis: Per 31 December 2024 independent valuation report (rate of lettable floor area $/sqm x NLA of the divested strata unit; income capitalisation, DCF, direct comparison methods); $15.4m sale = 19.6% above book value (footnote 2, p9)
